rationale: Both 4.70 ns runs passed with +0.29/+0.48 ns slack (T_eff 4.42/4.22). Setup limits only at ss 100C 1.60V (port and reg-to-reg paths within 0.09 ns); hold (>=+0.08 ns, no hold buffers), slew/cap (0 vs bar 89) and routing (DRC 0, wirelength ~7% over estimate) have ample room. Every well-configured run got lower T_eff from a tighter target, so aim at the 4.50 ns floor (period_frac 0.45), keeping the claim close to its target for re-runs. As the target cannot go lower, pin a high post-GRT setup margin so repair aims ~0.4 ns past it: the 4.221 run used 0.39 (vs 0.12 for 4.415) and its worst corner moved off max-RC. Keep the proven synthesis/placement/RC pins.
